purpose: Verify authorized Basic User can create an expense request and save as Draft
expected_result: Expense request created in DRAFT status with is_locked=False

purpose: Verify request creator can specify department, request_type, title, description, and total amount
action_or_input: Provide title='Lab Consumables', dept='CSE', type='expense', desc='Lab supplies'
expected_result: Attributes saved and retrievable on model

purpose: Verify request creator can attach itemized line items with receipt references
action_or_input: Add items with description, category, amount, receipt_reference
expected_result: ExpenseItems persisted with foreign key relation to request

purpose: Verify Draft can be saved even when submission-mandatory fields are incomplete
action_or_input: Save draft with empty items list or missing total
expected_result: Draft saved successfully without throwing validation error

purpose: Verify formal submission validates completeness and rejects incomplete requests
preconditions: Draft exists with zero line items
expected_result: DomainValidationError raised requiring title, department, positive amount and items

purpose: Verify formal submission locks ordinary post-submission editing
action_or_input: Check is_locked attribute and attempt direct modification
expected_result: is_locked is True and validate_record_not_locked blocks modification

purpose: Verify status progression and action history are preserved on request
expected_result: Audit trail records create and submit actions

purpose: Verify Finance Staff can review submitted request
expected_result: Request transitions to finance_validated

purpose: Verify finance review validates department budget availability
expected_result: Material anomaly created with category budget_insufficient

purpose: Verify Finance Staff can raise clarification query
expected_result: ClarificationQuery created, request status transitions to query_raised

purpose: Verify creator can respond to clarification query
expected_result: Query status updated to responded, request transitions to query_responded

purpose: Verify Finance Staff can validate request after clarification response
expected_result: Request transitions from query_responded to finance_validated

purpose: Verify validation assigns request into configured approval route
expected_result: Approver role and levels set based on amount hierarchy

purpose: Verify Finance Staff can record approved request
expected_result: Request status transitions to RECORDED

purpose: Verify recorded status is internal non-monetary completion
action_or_input: Inspect audit log details for record_processing
expected_result: Audit log records non_monetary=True without payment execution

purpose: Verify terminal recorded request is retained for audit
expected_result: Record is persistently accessible in read-only mode

purpose: Verify approval routing determined by amount and hierarchy rules
preconditions: Hierarchy rules configured for expense requests
expected_result: Returns 1 level for <25k and 2 levels for >=25k

purpose: Verify HoD, Dean, and Director preserved as distinct authorities
action_or_input: Check approver roles returned in hierarchy route
expected_result: Roles match ['HOD'], ['HOD', 'Dean'], or ['HOD', 'Dean', 'Director']

purpose: Verify segregation of duties blocks creator from approving own request
preconditions: Request created by user_id 1001 in FINANCE_VALIDATED
action_or_input: user_id 1001 attempts to record approval decision
expected_result: DomainValidationError raised for segregation of duties violation

purpose: Verify approval decision requires non-empty remarks
action_or_input: Approver calls record_request_decision with empty remarks
expected_result: DomainValidationError raised requiring mandatory remarks

purpose: Verify rejection decision transitions request to REJECTED
action_or_input: Approver rejects request with valid remarks
expected_result: Status updated to REJECTED and ApprovalAction recorded

purpose: Verify intermediate approval level advances current_approval_level
expected_result: Status becomes APPROVAL_PENDING and current_approval_level becomes 2

purpose: Verify final approval level transitions request to APPROVED
preconditions: Request at final level in APPROVAL_PENDING
expected_result: Status transitions to APPROVED

purpose: Verify detection of pending approvals exceeding SLA timeout duration
preconditions: Request approval assigned 4 days ago with 3-day SLA
expected_result: Overdue request identified for escalation

purpose: Verify timed escalation transitions request to ESCALATED
expected_result: Request status updated to ESCALATED

purpose: Verify escalation reassigns request to higher authority
expected_result: assigned_approver_role set to Director

purpose: Verify escalation action logged in audit trail
action_or_input: Query audit logs for target request
expected_result: AuditLogEntry with action='timeout_escalate' and resulting_status='escalated'

purpose: Verify Basic User can submit Travel Allowance claim
action_or_input: Call submit_travel_claim with valid journey dates and locations
expected_result: TAClaim created in SUBMITTED status with is_locked=True

purpose: Verify TA claim rejects return date earlier than departure date
expected_result: DomainValidationError raised for invalid journey dates

purpose: Verify TA claim rejects zero or negative claimed amounts
expected_result: DomainValidationError raised requiring positive claimed amount

purpose: Verify post-submission lock on TA claim
expected_result: is_locked is True and blocks direct modifications

purpose: Verify itemized TA expense legs persisted with claim
preconditions: Submit claim with flight and hotel items
expected_result: Line items persisted with expense_type, amount, and details

purpose: Verify Finance Staff can verify submitted TA claim
expected_result: Claim verified against policy parameters

purpose: Verify standard TA claim (< threshold) transitions to VERIFIED
expected_result: Status becomes VERIFIED and is_high_value is False

purpose: Verify TA clarification query and response cycle
expected_result: Status cycles SUBMITTED -> QUERY_RAISED -> QUERY_RESPONDED

purpose: Verify Finance Staff can reject TA claim during verification
expected_result: Claim transitions to REJECTED status

purpose: Verify claims >= high_value threshold route to APPROVAL_PENDING
expected_result: Status becomes APPROVAL_PENDING, is_high_value=True, assigned_approver_role='Dean'

purpose: Verify Dean or Director can approve high-value TA claim
action_or_input: Dean calls record_travel_decision with approve and remarks
expected_result: Status transitions to APPROVED

purpose: Verify claimant segregation of duties enforced on high-value TA
action_or_input: user_id 1001 attempts to record travel approval decision
expected_result: DomainValidationError raised for segregation of duties violation

purpose: Verify Finance Staff can record verified or approved TA claim
preconditions: TA claim in VERIFIED or APPROVED status
expected_result: Claim status transitions to RECORDED

purpose: Verify TA recording is non-monetary governance record
expected_result: Audit log records action without executing banking payment

purpose: Verify terminal RECORDED TA claim is retained
expected_result: Claim accessible in read-only mode and blocks state transitions

purpose: Verify automatic anomaly trigger when department budget is exceeded
preconditions: Request amount exceeds department available budget
expected_result: Anomaly created with category='budget_insufficient' in OPEN status

purpose: Verify Finance Staff can manually flag material anomaly
expected_result: Anomaly created in OPEN status with flagged_by_role='finance_staff'

purpose: Verify Auditor can manually flag material anomaly
expected_result: Anomaly created in OPEN status with flagged_by_role='audit_officer'

purpose: Verify open anomaly references target entity and type
expected_result: reference_type='request' and reference_id=12

purpose: Verify anomaly assigns resolver role
expected_result: resolver_role set to 'finance_staff' or configured role

purpose: Verify designated resolver can resolve anomaly with remarks
expected_result: Status becomes RESOLVED, resolution_remarks saved, resolved_by_id populated

purpose: Verify resolver can escalate anomaly to higher review
expected_result: Status becomes ESCALATED

purpose: Verify escalated anomaly can be resolved
expected_result: Status transitions from ESCALATED to RESOLVED

purpose: Verify Auditor can raise audit observation on department
action_or_input: Call raise_audit_observation with department='ME', title='Inventory gap'
expected_result: AuditObservation created in OPEN status

purpose: Verify observation title is mandatory
expected_result: BadRequestError raised requiring mandatory title

purpose: Verify department representative can submit response to observation
expected_result: response_text saved, responded_by_id populated, status becomes RESPONDED

purpose: Verify response text cannot be empty
expected_result: BadRequestError raised requiring response text

purpose: Verify Auditor can review departmental response
expected_result: Observation response details visible to auditor

purpose: Verify satisfactory response transitions observation to CLOSED
expected_result: Status becomes CLOSED and closed_at is populated

purpose: Verify unsatisfactory response returns observation to OPEN
expected_result: Status transitions back to OPEN (cyclic loop per IAA-BR-301)

purpose: Verify department expenditure summary report generation
expected_result: Returns aggregated department expenditure totals

purpose: Verify budget utilization calculation per department
preconditions: Department budgets allocated and vouchers recorded
expected_result: available_amount correctly calculated as allocated minus utilized

purpose: Verify CSV report export streaming
expected_result: Streaming CSV response with appropriate header attachment

purpose: Verify System Admin can configure active financial year
expected_result: Active configuration updated with new financial year

purpose: Verify System Admin can configure high-value TA threshold
expected_result: Configuration threshold updated and reflected in TA verification

purpose: Verify System Admin can configure approval SLA timeout days
expected_result: Approval timeout days updated to 5

purpose: Verify System Admin can manage department budget allocations
expected_result: DepartmentBudget allocated_amount updated

purpose: Verify Basic User visibility is scoped strictly to own records
preconditions: Requests exist for user 1001 and user 2002
expected_result: Returns only user 1001 records (IAA-BR-501)

purpose: Verify System Admin restricted from operational transactions
expected_result: Returns empty queryset (.none()) enforcing operational separation

purpose: Verify out-of-scope detail endpoint returns 404 rather than 403
preconditions: Request #2 belongs to user 2002; client is user 1001
expected_result: HTTP 404 Not Found returned (ADR-0004 scoping)

purpose: Verify Finance Staff with view_all permission sees all operational records
expected_result: Returns complete un-filtered queryset of requests

purpose: Verify all financial request state transitions generate audit log
expected_result: Entries present for create_request_draft, submit_request, finance_validate

purpose: Verify TA claim state transitions generate audit log
expected_result: Audit log records submit_travel_claim and verify_travel_claim

purpose: Verify audit log immutably preserves acting role
expected_result: acting_role matches 'finance_staff' preserving historical integrity

purpose: Verify anomaly and audit observation transitions generate audit log
action_or_input: Query AuditLogEntry for anomaly and audit observation
expected_result: Audit entries recorded with target_type 'anomaly' and 'audit_observation'

purpose: Verify notification dispatched on formal submission
expected_result: Notification logged with target_type 'request' and recipient

purpose: Verify notification dispatched on approval/rejection decision
expected_result: Notification sent to request creator regarding decision

purpose: Verify notification dispatched on clarification query
expected_result: Notification sent to creator regarding pending clarification
